name: package-manifest-update
body: The release workflow updates the Homebrew formula (`Formula/kalide.rb`) and Scoop manifest (`bucket/kalide.json`) to the new version, `kalide-<os>-<arch>` asset URLs and SHA-256 checksums for each target, and pushes them as a manifest-only commit to really-knows-ai/kalide (the one CI push the humans-push-and-tag constraint allows). AC: after a release, both files reference the new version and their checksums match the published assets; the CI commit touches only files under `Formula/` and `bucket/`; CI creates no tags.
